architecture.summary: SO-05 adds the MCP gateway of the control plane and the relay route POST /internal/audit behind the switch MCP_TENANTS_ENABLED (default off; off keeps the behavior of today and reads none of the new settings, and FREE_TENANT_LIMIT is read only with the switch on). With the switch on, the Origin check of app and the bearer and access checks of MCPServer run as today; then MCPServer gives each admitted request to its new forward step, the gateway of mcp, in place of the local MCP server. The gateway reads the row of the organization through a port that app composes on the tenants owner (no mcp -> tenants import). A live row gets a light streaming proxy to internal_url with a Thermus-Access context that the existing AccessContextSigner signs with GATEWAY_SIGNING_KEY, without hop-by-hop headers, the cookie, or a client context, and with the 4 MiB body limit of the SDK; the gateway reads only the JSON-RPC id, method, and tool name. Each other row answers 503 with its words: Retry-After 15 for requested, creating, deploying, a live row without an address, and a registry copy older than 60 s; Retry-After 60 after one resume of a suspended row (one conditional UPDATE moves the row to deploying, only that call sends the resume through a supplied operation, and a failed resume moves the row back); a failed row reports to the operator one time; deleted gets its words; no row requests a tenant inside the cap or gets the capacity message. A tenant failure before the first answer byte gives the tool error 'Server restarted. Try again in a minute.' (a JSON-RPC error for another method); after it, the stream ends; both write one operator report. 5 searches at a time pass across all tenants, told from a fetch by the tool name. last_active_at is written at most once a minute through a narrow store statement. Each refusal writes one system log line and no audit event. The relay route answers only the host of CONTROL_PLANE_INTERNAL_URL (404 on the public host and for other /internal/ paths), checks the context with the public key of GATEWAY_SIGNING_KEY for the organization and the user of the event (identity gains verifyRelay: no bearer token, 30 s grace), drops a repeated operation ID within 160 s, and captures the event through AuditLog, which checks the relayed event again (new declarations relayedToolCompletion and toolRelayed of the public module audit-log.ts). New public module src/runtime/http/bounded-body.ts: the bounded body read that mcp and web share. New contracts: the gateway answers to MCP clients with the switch on, and POST /internal/audit between the tenant server and the control plane. The resume operation is connected to Render in SO-10. Registry: the hosted container view, the tenant role view, the tenant registry view, and the collaboration overview are edited; the gateway component view and the gateway scenario are added; the container table, ownership, behavior, Render target, and soft spots gain the gateway; the other views stay accurate. Policy (manager decision of 27 October 2026): the five admission files of the gateway and the relay route (mcp-gateway.ts, mcp-gateway-forward.ts, mcp-gateway-headers.ts, audit-relay-route.ts, and audit-relay-check.ts) join protected_paths.security, so a later change to them needs at least T1 Team review.
